bgp-bestpath-multiprefix.fix: showcase: r1 sets LocalPref 150 (not 50) on r2's route, so r2 is best for 8.8.8.0/24

q1-static.fix: Q1: r1's interface is no longer shut down, so sv reaches 8.8.8.8

q2-static.fix: Q2: r1 gets a default route (staticd on) so sv reaches any internet address

q3-ospf.fix: Q3: r1 runs OSPF on the r1-r2 link, so the neighbor comes up Full

q4-static.fix: Q4: r1's static route to 2.2.2.2 uses the real next hop on the link

q5-ospf.fix: Q5: r1's OSPF hello interval matches r2

q5-ospf-iol.fix: Q5 (IOL): r1's OSPF hello interval matches r2

q6-ospf.fix: Q6: r2's OSPF hello interval matches on the redundant path, so failover works

q7-ospf-static.fix: Q7: r1's static route with an unreachable next hop is removed (staticd off), so the OSPF route to 2.2.2.2 is used

q8-ospf.fix: Q8: r1's link network is in OSPF area 0 like r2

q9-ospf.fix: Q9 (fix r1 only): r1's OSPF router-id no longer duplicates r2 (backup path) and the primary static route uses r3's link address

q10-ospf.fix: Q10: r1's interface is no longer OSPF passive

q11-ospf-static.fix: Q11: r1's static route via r2 is removed (staticd off), so the direct OSPF route is used

q12-ospf-static.fix: Q12: r1's r1-r3 network goes to area 0, and a floating static route (AD 120) via r2 is the backup

q13-bgp-static.fix: Q13: r1's BGP neighbor is r2's real address 10.10.0.20

q14-bgp.fix: Q14: r1 sources the loopback iBGP session from lo

q15-bgp-ospf-static.fix: Q15: r2 sets next-hop-self toward r1

q15-bgp-ospf-static-iol.fix: Q15 (IOL): r2 sets next-hop-self toward r1

q16-bgp.fix: Q16: r1 advertises its loopback 1.1.1.1/32 in BGP

q17-ospf-static.fix: Q17: the redistribution route-map on r1 permits the static route into OSPF

q19-bgp.fix: Q19: r1 accepts up to 15 routes from r2 and rejects all RFC 1918 ranges

removed: ip prefix-list NO-BOGON seq 10 permit 172.16.0.0/12 le 32
added: ip prefix-list NO-BOGON seq 10 deny 172.16.0.0/12 le 32
ip prefix-list NO-BOGON seq 15 deny 192.168.0.0/16 le 32

q20-bgp.fix: Q20: r1 no longer applies the OUTBOUND route-map to r2

q21-bgp-lp.fix: Q21: r1 sets LocalPref 150 (not 50) on r2's route, so the fast ISP is best and r3 stays as backup

q21-bgp-lp-iol.fix: Q21 (IOL): r1 sets LocalPref 150 (not 50) on r2's route, so the fast ISP is best and r3 stays as backup
